what: The island model per beach (sim/probes.py). K[dir/T][probe] = Hs at the probe / Hs offshore for a swell from dir (deg) of period T (s), linear (breaking is applied by model/surf.js when the forecast is known); probes sorted by depth h (m), m = metres from the anchor; ang[dir/T] = the direction the waves travel TOWARD at probe angProbe (deg), null where the central ray family never reached it; fetch[i] = metres of water up-wind for a wind from i*22.5 deg (-1 = open sea); edges = km to the box side edges that cross the sea.
